text:
noah (Eng): Quick question 3: my primary care visit yesterday was processed with a higher member responsibility than I expected. The EOB shows the provider as 'Partners Primary Care (billing under Partners Health Systems TIN)'. The UnitedCare directory shows Partners Primary Care as in-network but maybe under a different tax ID. Claim #: 994400221.

yasmin (People Ops): Thanks for flagging. Which plan? That will determine in-network rules (PPO vs HMO).

noah (Eng): RW-PPO-2025. Attached EOB and a screenshot from the online directory.

benefits-bot: Plan: RW-PPO-2025 (UnitedCare). Directory snapshot (2025-04-20): Partners Primary Care 3 In-Network (practice group level). Appeal phone: 1-800-555-9012.

harbor-broker (Ara): Hi Noah 3 likely the claim was billed under the hospital system's tax ID which isn't linked to the participating contract. I'll contact UnitedCare to check mapping. Please keep copies of EOB, appointment confirmation and any billing statements.

yasmin (People Ops): We have a short appeal text you can paste:

"""
To whom it may concern,

Please reconsider Claim #994400221 for services dated 2025-04-19 billed by Partners Primary Care (Member ID: XXXXXXX). The UnitedCare directory lists this practice group as participating in-network. The claim was adjudicated as out-of-network due to billing under Partners Health Systems TIN. Please reprocess under the in-network contract and adjust member liability. Attached: EOB, directory screenshot, appointment confirmation.

Thank you,
[Member Name]
"""

clare (Finance): Reminder: submit receipts to Finance if you ask for an advance. We'll need the EOB and a note on whether this is an emergency vs routine.

noah (Eng): Filing the appeal now, will post the insurer case number here. Thanks! :thumbsup:
